jobs_results.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

We are in Business for People, empowering people in service organizations with innovative Enterprise and Business software solutions. We’ve innovated and taken a new approach to delivering ERP that works for people. Self-driving, adaptive and intuitive software that is changing the way people work. Our solutions empower people and deliver a better people experience so people can spend time on meaningful high value work they live for.

Read more on our website about how we transform work and how people feel about it, so our customers and their people can thrive.

Job Description

As a DevOps Automation Engineer you will:
• work with our Cloud Operations Engineers to contribute to new features and ideas.
• produce status reports detailing project activities.
• work with Service Delivery on problem remediation via automation and scripting
• work with cross-functional technical teams to extended automation capabilities
• identify and deploy internal process and... automation improvements
• work as a Technical escalation point for the global Ops support team
• contribute to the development and maintenance of the existing Azure pipelines, Azure boards, and Git repositories, with a roadmap of key deliverables and timelines
• create and maintain detailed and accurate documentation, knowledge base articles.

Qualifications
• Excellent verbal and written communication
• Good Windows Server OS knowledge
• Advanced knowledge of PowerShell
• Good Knowledge of Active Directory
• Experience with JSON files
• Knowledge of Application deployment
• Continuous improvement mindset
• Attention to detail and a security-minded approach to solving problems
• Strong problem-solving skills. The ability to adapt and overcome is a must
• Ability to drive concurrent projects and initiatives while managing operational issues
• Comfortable working in hyper-growth environments
• Knowledge and experience with Azure Resource Manager templates (ARM)
• Knowledge on CI CD pipelines

Nice to have
• Azure Administrator certification
• Azure DevOps Engineer Expert certification

Additional Information

A chance to participate in the development of a leading global software firm. You have the opportunity to work within an organization, that gives you the freedom and autonomy to be successful. An attractive salary while working in a challenging international environment with enthusiastic colleagues who like to learn from each other.

At Unit4 we invest in your personal and professional growth. We don't focus on how many days you work, we trust you on delivering results - thus, we have an unlimited vacation policy

jobs_results.title: IT Operations Engineer (DevOps)
jobs_results.description:
Our Operations Team runs customer-facing systems as well as our internal IT infrastructure. As a DevOps Engineer you will be responsible for the setup, configuration, monitoring and troubleshooting of our Linux-based infrastructure.

About the job:
• We run software like nginx, PHP 8, MariaDB, Solr, Redis and RabbitMQ
• We work according to the principle “Infrastructure as Code” with Continuous Integration Patterns using Jenkins and Ansible
• We design and implement monitoring and alerting solutions (Grafana, InfluxDB, New Relic, etc.)
• As part of our DevOps team, you will be responsible for the administration and design of Linux-based cloud, container, and dedicated systems (Debian, Alpine)
• You will work closely together with the Engineering teams on performance, scalability and operability

What you bring along:
• Secure handling of configuration management tools (ideally Ansible)
• Experience with Docker Containers and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins)
• Good knowledge of a scripting... language (e.g. Bash, Python, Groovy etc.)
• Debugging and troubleshooting skills in a distributed environment
• Experience in running a large-scale relational database system (MySQL, MariaDB) is a plus

Are you the right one for the job?
Then send us your application (CV and cover letter) today!

If you want to know more about your future team and what working at InterNations is like, just have a look at this interview with one of our DevOps Engineers on our corporate blog

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
What's Red Points all about?

Red Points is the most widely used solution to recover digital revenue. Over 1.000 companies rely on our platform to fight counterfeits, piracy, impersonation, and distribution abuse. They leverage Red Points to take back the revenue that’s rightfully theirs. With 270+ professionals and offices in New York, Barcelona, Beijing, and Salt Lake City, Red Points has disrupted an industry traditionally led by service providers with a scalable, cost-effective solution.

Our B Corp certification reinforces our commitment to making a positive impact on the world.

Be part of the change: join us on our mission to make the Internet a safer place!

Job Description

Our day-to-day tools and technologies:
• Prometheus querying and administration (with Thanos)
• AWS management
• Grafana dashboard creation and administration
• Kubernetes cluster management (+10 EKS clusters)
• Helm development (Modularization)
• Terraform development (Modularization)
• Scripting (python... and/or shell scripting)
• Log management (Loki)
• Infrastructure monitorization

Qualifications

Requirements
• Experienced with Kubernetes management and development
• Proven experience with helm development
• SDL approach and structured mindset for DevOps tasks and code
• Encourage best practices for software development in DevOps tasks
• Terraform knowledge (modularization, best practices…)
• Experience in observability (preferably prometheus+grafana experience)
• AWS Knowledge
• Be open to receiving constructive feedback
• Ability to clearly and effectively communicate ideas and solutions to stakeholders.
• Collaborative mindset
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Fluent English level

Nice to have
• Python development experience
• Advanced AWS
• EKS knowledge

Additional Information

What we offer
• A friendly, diverse, and international team.
• You’ll have top-notch Private Health Insurance, fully covered by the company.
• 23 working days of holidays per year, plus the local public holidays.
• Indefinite Contract.
• Fridays we have reduced working hours. And every weekday during August.
• Tax relief/ ¨Retribución Flexible¨ will also be available for you.
• We offer a discount with the amazing DIR gyms!
• We have a Referral policy with a very sweet Bonus scheme.
• We have a hybrid model, with a flexible start time.
• At the office, we offer fresh fruit, and a huge variety of different kinds of milk, coffee, thé, and cereals.
• We also host monthly after works and internal events with guest speakers that allow us to share good times together and learn something new!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We encourage all applicants, regardless of race, religion or belief (if any), color, nationality, ethnic or national origin, gender, gender identity, pregnancy and maternity, sexual orientation, age, marital and civil partnership status, or disability status.

If you think this is the right move for you and you match the description, just apply! We'll get in touch with you for an interview if you are one of the selected candidates

jobs_results.title: File-Service DevOps Expert in Workplace Services
jobs_results.description:
Are you an experienced DevOps professional with a passion for automation and a drive to deliver seamless workplace services? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Workplace Services (WPS) department at Allianz Group as a File-Service DevOps Expert.

As part of our Workplace DevOps Team, your main responsibility will be to drive the automation of service delivery and migration processes. Working closely with our WPS product teams, you will collaborate to successfully meet their automation goals. This role also involves supporting the agile transformation of the department and maintaining a mindset that keeps automation at the forefront of your daily activities.

You will:
• Plan, develop, test, and deploy our automation platform, primarily written in Python, to provide our services to Allianz employees worldwide.
• Maintain an application built by an external company on Kubernetes, including deployment, automating updates and bug fixes, and configuration of the... application itself.
• Discuss new requirements with experts on the customer side and drive their implementation.
• Support the design and implementation of File-Service components according to the architecture roadmap.
• Collaborate with expert teams in Workplace Services for the exchange of best practices and process management training.

Your skills:
• Completed degree in computer science or a comparable qualification.
• Expert knowledge in Python Coding
• Expert knowledge in working with Kubernetes.
• Advanced knowledge in working with Microsoft Azure.
• Advanced knowledge in automated testing.
• Advanced knowledge in working with CI/CD pipelines.
• Basic knowledge in working with SQL.
• Basic knowledge in technologies like Windows Server, Filesystems (DFS-R, DFS-N)
• Experience in Agile Work environments and corresponding tools and methods (preferably SCRUM)
• Self-oriented working, prioritization capabilities and the ability to cope under stress.
• Curiosity about modern technologies and interest in intercultural cooperation.
• Good spoken and written English skills.
• Professional experience for several years.

Your benefits:
• We offer a hybrid work model which recognizes the value of striking a balance between in-person collaboration and remote working incl. up to 25 days per year working from abroad.
• We believe in rewarding performance and our compensation and benefits package includes a company bonus scheme, pension, employee shares program and multiple employee discounts (details vary by location).
• From career development and digital learning programs to international career mobility, we offer lifelong learning for our employees worldwide and an environment where innovation, delivery and empowerment are fostered.
• Flexible working, health and wellbeing offers (including healthcare and parental leave benefits) support to balance family and career and help our people return from career breaks with experience that nothing else can teach.

About Allianz Technology

Allianz Technology is the global IT service provider for Allianz and delivers IT solutions that drive the digitalization of the Group. With more than 13,000 employees located in 22 countries around the globe, Allianz Technology works together with other Allianz entities in pioneering the digitalization of the financial services industry.

We oversee the full digitalization spectrum – from one of the industry’s largest IT infrastructure projects that includes data centers, networking and security, to application platforms that span from workplace services to digital interaction. In short, we deliver full-scale, end-to-end IT solutions for Allianz in the digital age.

D&I statement

Allianz Technology is proud to be an equal opportunity employer encouraging diversity in the working environment. We are interested in your strengths and experience. We welcome all applications from all people regardless of gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, race or ethnicity, age, nationality, religion, disability, or philosophy of life.

Join us. Let´s care for tomorrow.

You. IT

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Are you passionate about modern technology? Are you a bright and cross-functional team player? Then we want to hear from you. We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, Monitoring & Alerting and support the whole development cycle. You will drive and enforce standardization, simplification and scalability by taking over responsibility as DevOps bringing in new ideas and solutions. You will also give support to development teams in their projects in different technology platforms within a cross functional team.

What You Will Do
• build and maintain CI/CD pipelines giving support to projects and software solutions
• improve application monitoring, alerting, scalability, performance and security in different infrastructure platforms
• stay on top of the latest technologies and best practices in DevOps, sharing your knowledge and discussing about best solutions and practices

What You Bring
• strong DevOps mindset with capability of working with... standardized tools along the whole software delivery life-cycle
• experience in programming, containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, etc.), and CI/CD pipeline implementation (GitLab, Helm, etc.) applying GitOps principles in Linux environments
• know-how in log aggregation tools (e.g. Splunk) with knowledge and experience in monitoring and alerting (Grafana, Prometheus, etc.)
• other technologies as Ansible, Kafka, Vault, will be a plus
• communicative team-player, able to coordinate, steer and make decisions
• good verbal and written English and Spanish to interact with local and international colleagues from other locations

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $2B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.

As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva OpenData supports the industry by providing real-time reference data across the complete healthcare ecosystem... to support commercial sales execution, compliance, and business analytics. We drive value to our customers through constant innovation, using cloud-based solutions and state-of-the-art technologies to deliver product excellence and customer success. The OpenData Global Data Tools team delivers the tools and data processing pipelines used to build the global data core for life sciences in 100+ countries.

As a DevOps engineer contributing to the Global Data Tools team, you will manage the cloud system architecture and provisioning of cloud resources. You will also define the templates to configure CI/CD pipeline runs, build container agents, interconnect distributed resources, and apply security patches. You will promote and develop DevOps practices in the OpenData team.

This is a Work Anywhere position – you can choose to work remotely, or in one of our offices. Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status for this position and you must already hold legal work authorization without needing an employer’s support.
What You'll Do
• Design, provision, and manage cloud computer clusters and storage solutions using Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code over AWS resources
• Manage the CI/CD tooling and the integration with other company resources in the cloud
• Manage containers, repositories, and container orchestrators in AWS
• Define data processing pipelines deployment and execution through source code and CI/CD (Pipelines as Code)
• Maintain source, container, and artifact repositories
• Apply security patches to AWS resources
• Being the DevOps evangelist
Requirements
• 3+ years experience as a DevOps engineer for a data processing platform
• Proficient in “Pipeline as Code” definitions in a DevOps platform such as GitLab or Git Hub
• Experience modeling system infrastructure in the cloud with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Terraform
• Previous experience delivering containerized deployable platform resources over Kubernetes in AWS
• Previous cloud experience provisioning and patching EC2 instances and managing network connectivity for groups of resources in AWS
• Shell and python script development skills
Nice to Have
• Experience managing GitLab pipelines and runners
• Hands-on experience with one or more configuration management tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet
• Experience using DevOps tools to deploy and administer clusters in a managed Apache Spark platform in the cloud (e.g., Databricks, AWS EMR)
Perks & Benefits
• Benefits package including Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), family health insurance, and contributions to private pension plans
• Annual allocations for continuous learning, development & charitable contributions
• Fitness reimbursement
• Work anywhere

#RemoteSpain

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

As an equal opportunity employer, Veeva is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and growing a diverse workforce. Diversity makes us stronger. It comes in many forms. Gender, race, ethnicity, religion, politics, sexual orientation, age, disability and life experience shape us all into unique individuals. We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need when applying for a role or in our recruitment process, please contact us at

talent_accommodations@veeva.com
.

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Description

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURE

We’re currently seeking a DevOps Engineer to help our team on their next adventure. You will join an international and successful team and will report to the Tech Lead.

Your daily adventure :
• Administrate our cloud infrastructure in AWS and private cloud. Suggest improvements to the current setup.
• Provide technical guidance and educate team members on best practices in operations.
• Monitor metrics, provide observability to our infrastructure components and perform security audits.
• Define how to automate processes as well as deployment tasks. Own the deployment process to both internal and production environments.
• Set up CI / CD pipelines and educate the development teams to enforce a DevOps transformation.
• Update the DevOps processes for environment management including infrastructure, platform, and application lifecycle.
• Develop and document administration standards and procedures for internal and first-line support operations.
•... Periodically offer round-the-clock third-line support of the production environments, as part of a rotating on-call duty.

Qualifications

This is your life at AstraZeneca

jobs_results.title: SRE/Devops Inglés alto
jobs_results.description:
¿Dónde vas a trabajar?

Empresa internacional

¿Qué harás en tu nuevo puesto?

Responsibilities
• Document and share any work knowledge, incident experiences, and any improvements with the team
• Participate in mentoring and coaching new and junior employees or new members of team
• Participate and contribute to the community of knowledge sharing of SRE practices. For example, Solution Monitoring program
• Implement solution monitoring and observability monitoring, automate detections and responses
• Implement SLI and SLO measurements and monitoring in our Solution Monitoring
• Conduct Service improvement actions and review with the team using data from SLI and SLO
• Troubleshoot incidents, post-incidents analysis, perform root cause analysis
• Implement workarounds to avoid recurrence of incidents, improvements to monitoring detection
• Implement Observability monitoring and perform distributed tracing analysis of applications
• Deployment of new application releases to the... preproduction and production environments
• Participate and contribute to automation in deployment, automated testing, and monitoring detection
• Collaborate with SQC team on testing automation deployment
• Collaborate with DevOps on continuous delivery
• Participate in solution FAT process and performance tests
• Drive the solution SAT process in collaboration with Development, DevOps, Platform teams
• Participate in the planning and review sessions with Development, DevOps, Platform teams
• Expand and grow the technical knowledge, skillsets, and expertise expected of an SRE
• Create and document any artifacts related to SRE practices, for example, good practices or patterns or customized dashboards or workarounds or troubleshooting methods, solution monitoring and observability improvements.
• ¿A quién buscamos (H/M/D)?

Knowledge, skills:

Language skills: Fluent in English

Others: Good written and verbal communication

Technical skills:

· Experience in troubleshooting or debugging applications and complex systems

· Understand application tracing and log analysis

· Strong knowledge of Linux and VM

· Hands-on experience in Shell Scripts

· Experience in application deployment, and deployment tools (e.g. Jenkins)

· Experience in programming and development at least one programming language (e.g. Python, C, Java, etc).

· Experience with incident resolution and root cause analysis and incident management

· Knowledge and experience in using JIRA, a ITSM ticketing tool and any documentation tools (e.g. Wiki)

· Knowledge and experience in Nagios and Splunk or similar tools

· Knowledge and experience in Dockers, OpenShift, Kubernetes or similar technologies

· Knowledge and experience in automation (e.g. Ansible) will be an advantage

¿Cuáles son tus beneficios?

50% remoto

beneficios
